implementation: observability.py adds frozen RelaySlo/RelaySloVerdict + run_observed_outbox_relay_once wrapping unchanged P18 run_outbox_relay_once; injected clock measures duration, failure_rate=failed/(published+failed) (0.0 if empty); emits exactly one compact outbox_relay.batch_completed JSON line via injected sink built from a single explicit allowlisted dict (event/service/env/timestamp/tenant_id (str-normalized)/correlation_id/published_count/failed_count/duration_seconds/failure_rate/latency_met/failure_rate_met/within_slo) through json.dumps(separators=",",":", ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) — ordinary readable JSON, no Unicode-escaping, no row IDs/data/payload/claim token/exception/stack ever included
scenarios: clean full drain + empty second pass both green; partial failure is failure-rate red with no id/exception leaked; deterministically slow full success is latency-red only
scope: one observed relay pass, additive module only
nonGoals: no change to run_outbox_relay_once/P18 semantics; no per-row logging, exporter, metrics backend, dashboard, alert transport; no consumer loop, retry policy, dead-letter queue
